They ordered a lot of food, because we had a reason to meet! We really liked it, all the food was A+. A cozy atmosphere where you feel like a restaurant, not a dining room! On the same evening, Queez-Please was held there, who is interested in it twice a week: Thursday, Sunday! A day later, we went to this cafe again and again the food pleased us. I really wanted to eat Tom Yam, but I heard there was no good Tom Yam in Vietnam. After all, I ordered it and it turned out to be very delicious, this evening there were lessons Bochata! In general, I highly recommend and I will come back here more than once!

Skip this place
Jun 2025 • Solo
Visiting Nha Trang and needed a change from all the asian food I have been eating. Passed by and noticed they had streak and I was in the mood for Kobe and it was on their menu. Asked what cut of kobe it was and the Russian waitress kept telling me it was from a cow. I explained that I knew that but what cut, sirloin, ribeye, strip. She had to go ask. told me it was ribeye and I ordered it along with sauteed vegetables as it came with nothing. Also ordered a 1/2 L draft IPA. Beer cam first, not real cold and basically flat. I said nothing as perhaps this is what this craft from them was supposed to be. Steak ordered medium. Came on the rare side but for me that is not a bad thing. Better rare than well done. Ultimately it was not worth it. It had flavor, but was a bit tough and should have cut like butter. But the big issue was it was really salty. It was 9pm, I was hungry, but the bottom line is it was a $40 disappointing dinner. My opinion

Happy mood around !
Dec 2023 • Family
Had Christmas Eve dinner here , was surrounded by nice paintings and heard owner Enriko's wife painted all art.

It's mixture of Spanish and east Europe cuisine , I liked paella and pasta , Caesar salad was very nice .

Christmas special turkey was yummy and I loved sangria .

If we should talk about food , cannot say it's very authentic , but it was kind of simple and family home style food , owner was kind and friendly , has good energy so was great time to enjoy Christmas Eve . 

We had good time , relaxed and happy , price is a bit higher than usual nha trang good but still very affordable price , go for amicable owner's laugh , it's good mood indeed !
